decisions.statement: Applicants are assigned to a workgroup only after a short call with that workgroup's lead.
The 2026 identity keeps the SciPy India mark and changes only the accent colour.
Reviewers see submissions anonymised for the first pass.
The code of conduct is adapted from the PSF template with an India-specific contact list.
Volunteer applications are collected through a Google Form and reviewed every two weeks.
The 2026 site reuses the 2025 template rather than starting over.
The tech park auditorium is confirmed for 10-12 December.
Three sponsor tiers: platinum, gold, community. Community tier is free for non-profits.
The CFP opens 16 February and closes 5 April. Review closes 26 April.
The shortlist is down to two: the university campus and the tech park auditorium.
SciPy India 2026 runs 11-12 December 2026, two conference days plus one workshop day on 10 December.
The organizing team meets every second Friday until the conference.
Ticket pricing stays at 2025 levels; a student tier is added.
